description: Root schema for the video generation task.

inputs.description: Input files and resources required for the video generation process.

processed_frames_zip_path.description: Path to the zip archive containing the processed frames to be compiled.

output_video_path.description: Path where the final generated video file will be saved.

config.description: Configuration settings for frame rate, resolution, encoding codec, and bitrate.

fps.description: Frames per second for the output video.

resolution.description: Target pixel dimensions for the output video.

codec.description: Video codec to use for encoding (e.g., libx264, mpeg4).

bitrate.description: Target bitrate for the video stream (e.g., 5M, 2000k).

results.description: Execution output details including final status and error logs if any.

status.description: Current status of the execution (e.g., success, error).

error.description: Error description if the video generation fails.

date_time.description: Timestamp of when the execution results were compiled in ISO 8601 format.
